list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete supertetrahedral tetramer: four [GdNi12(OH)6(W7O24)(SbO3)3(PW9O34)3(WO4)] monomers occupy its vertices and are interconnected by a [Gd6(H2O)18(SbO3)4] bridging unit. The cluster crystallizes in space group C2/c.

synthesis.procedure: Obtained by hydrothermal reaction of the B-α-SbW9O33 precursor with KH2PO4, NiCl2, and Gd2O3, replacing Er2O3 in the reaction described for compound 1. The main article does not give numerical reagent quantities or a complete procedure.
solvents: water (in the reaction mixture and hydrate)
synthesis.temperature: Reaction temperature gradually increased from 30 °C to 140 °C and maintained at 140 °C; subsequent evaporation at room temperature.
synthesis.time: Stirred 30 min at room temperature; held at 140 °C for 3 days; slowly cooled to 30 °C; evaporated approximately one week.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling, filtered into a 10 mL beaker and evaporated at room temperature for approximately one week, yielding green, irregularly shaped crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Reported as an isomorphic La analogue of the {W140Gd10Ni48} cluster. The rare-earth centers occupy 12-coordinate sites; the article does not provide a separate full molecular formula or crystallographic assignment for this analogue in the main text.

synthesis.procedure: The article states that La3+ affords the isomorphic {W140La10Ni48} cluster under identical synthetic conditions. It does not provide numerical reagent quantities or a distinct complete procedure in the main text.
